# Orbe

> Run your creator business on Orbe. Orbe helps creator businesses run content, go-to-market and the business faster and better, beside the tools they already use (Canva, CapCut and Descript for the work; Slack and Discord, coming) rather than replacing them. It is for every kind of creator business: YouTube, TikTok, Snapchat and X creators, podcasts, newsletters, and creator-led product companies selling hardware, software or physical goods. It rates a creator's work against creators of the same kind and size (zero is typical for your size band), prices sponsorships from what the creator's work actually delivers, gives an indicative value for a creator business with the fees in full, and checks whether a podcast's download claims fit public signals. Creators use the core free, with an optional plan for heavy use; brands, agencies, buyers and lenders pay, and Orbe earns when money moves. Every rating, band and benchmark is labelled "Independently calculated by Orbe." and carries the version of the published maths.

Status, honestly: the tools on this site run in your browser on Orbe's own engine code, on made-up or typed figures. The HTTP API exists in the code but is not hosted yet. Anything that needs it (live connections to a creator's accounts, a hosted endpoint, API keys) is marked "With the API" on the pages. Example figures on the site are made up and labelled so.

## For agents

- [For developers and agents](https://eoinforker.github.io/orbe-site/developers/): the twelve tools, the MCP config and a live playground that runs the MCP server's own code in the browser.
- [OpenAPI 3.1](https://eoinforker.github.io/orbe-site/developers/openapi.json): the same capabilities. Paths marked x-status: routed exist in the API's code and run locally; paths marked x-status: planned are not routed yet.

The MCP server (stdio, JSON-RPC 2.0, protocol revision 2025-06-18) runs locally from the repository with `node product/src/mcp/server.ts`. It makes no network calls and keeps nothing. Tools:

- orbe_rate: the Orbe Rating for a creator's recent works against their size band, with sub-scores, the #1 stat, what to work on and a rating per work.
- orbe_benchmark: typical figures for a kind of creator and size band, and the provisional sponsorship rate cards.
- orbe_price_sponsorship: a suggested price range per sponsorship format, with reasons and sources. The creator sets their own price.
- orbe_fair_offer: whether a sponsorship offer is below, within or above that range, and a counter when it is low.
- orbe_value_business: an indicative value range for a creator business on trailing profit, with Orbe's fees at each end. Not advice and not an offer.
- orbe_podcast_plausibility: whether a podcast's claimed downloads fit Orbe's measurement, OP3, the public feed, YouTube, charts and ratings. It never accuses.
- orbe_explain_rating: the rating in plain English.
- orbe_quote_guaranteed_read: a quote for a sponsorship the brand pays in full only on verified delivery, with the guaranteed floor and the shortfall terms. A quote, never a booking.
- orbe_check_delivery: delivered or short against a guarantee, the creator's options when short, and the split between creator, Orbe and the brand's refund.
- orbe_diagnose_upload: whether a YouTube upload is below creators its size at its age, and whether the title, the thumbnail or both are the lever.
- orbe_judge_fix: whether a new title or thumbnail lifted an upload against its own sealed pace, and the fee only if it did.
- orbe_retention_cuts: from a video's audience retention curve, how many are still watching after the opening, the steepest drops, and up to three stretches worth tightening or cutting. Read only.

Works today: the playground and the MCP server run locally. With the API: a hosted endpoint, keys, rate limits and data from connected accounts. For access, write to hello@orbe.vc.

## Pages

- [Home](https://eoinforker.github.io/orbe-site/): what Orbe is, and reserving a handle.
- [All products](https://eoinforker.github.io/orbe-site/products/): every tool, running in the browser.
- [Rate my work](https://eoinforker.github.io/orbe-site/products/rate/): the rating against creators your size.
- [Your Orbe](https://eoinforker.github.io/orbe-site/products/you/): your highlights, against your size.
- [Podcasts](https://eoinforker.github.io/orbe-site/products/podcasts/): free measurement for podcasts.
- [Sponsorships](https://eoinforker.github.io/orbe-site/products/sponsorships/): price a slot and match brand briefs.
- [Selling](https://eoinforker.github.io/orbe-site/products/selling/): an indicative value, with the fees in full.
- [Diligence](https://eoinforker.github.io/orbe-site/products/diligence/): the report a buyer reads first.
- [Roster](https://eoinforker.github.io/orbe-site/products/roster/): for managers, every creator they look after.
- [For teams](https://eoinforker.github.io/orbe-site/teams/): rights tooling for agencies, brands and media companies.
- [Pricing](https://eoinforker.github.io/orbe-site/pricing/): free for creators; what teams and deals pay.

## Answers

- [Is this offer fair for my size?](https://eoinforker.github.io/orbe-site/answers/is-this-offer-fair/): a live fair-offer check for creators.
- [Should I take equity instead of cash?](https://eoinforker.github.io/orbe-site/answers/equity-or-cash/): an illustrative equity check, not advice.
- [Who owns my video after a brand deal?](https://eoinforker.github.io/orbe-site/answers/who-owns-my-video/): usage rights, explained, with a live checker.
